method: llvm-objdump -d --triple=armv7-linux-gnueabi for libcameraex client A32 code

findings.claim: startPreviewSequence creates SDCom parameters and sends message 0x124 through CameraSeqUtil.
getPreviewSequenceFrames sends SDCom 0x127 with parameter ID 5 and creates DeviceMemoryDiadem objects from response vectors.
DeviceMemoryDiadem retains a ticket and release sends SDCom 0x3 with parameter ID 4 carrying that ticket.
readBuffer maps shared memory, copies a bounded byte range and unmaps it.
Camseq StartPreview requires a job, validates parameter 0x3001 and registers wait event 0x1e06.
Dedicated Camseq processors exist for frame/info/start/stop/store operations.
Ticket plus explicit release is a remote resource-loan contract, but reference counting and terminal ownership are not recovered.
640 is a local default, but 640x480, JPEG format, JPEG producer, YC format and full ownership are not established.
No static edge links CameraSequence to S2, Silent/EFCS, MPR EncodeStill/WriteStill, DCF or a physical capture producer.
A DeviceMemory read is not proof of JPEG decoding, JPEG validity, raster YC or SilentShutter functionality.

next_task: (a) entrega del YC de SFRA al cliente Linux
safety: Static local analysis only; original binaries untouched; no Ghidra project modified; no camera connected or flashed; SilentShutter is not declared functional.
